resources.string: Ad Skipper
Ad Skipper
Watches YouTube and its picture-in-picture window for a visible "Skip Ad" control and activates it when it appears. Reads screen content from YouTube only.
Service is ON. Skippable YouTube ads will be skipped automatically.
Service is OFF. Turn it on to start skipping ads.
Service was stopped by the system. Accessibility settings will still show Ad Skipper as ON — turn it off and back on again to restart it.
Service is running but Android is not letting it read the screen, so no ads will be skipped. Turn Ad Skipper off and back on in Accessibility settings.
Android does not let an app switch on its own accessibility service, so this last step is manual:\n\nSettings > Accessibility > Installed apps > Ad Skipper > On
Could not open Accessibility settings on this device. Open Settings and look for Accessibility > Installed apps > Ad Skipper.
Open Accessibility settings
Open App info (battery settings)
Could not open App info on this device. Open Settings > Apps and find Ad Skipper.
Could not open battery optimisation settings. Open App info and remove any battery restriction on Ad Skipper.
Could not open notification settings. Open App info > Notifications and allow them for Ad Skipper.
Setup checks
Fix this
The YouTube app is installed
Notifications are allowed (needed to warn you when it stops)
Battery restrictions are removed
Step this app cannot check
I have allowed Ad Skipper to keep running in the background on this device
This app cannot verify this — Android provides no way to read it. Ticking this is your confirmation, not a check the app has performed.

Accessibility cannot be enabled from here until the checks above pass. Turning the service on before the device is set up to keep it running produces an app that works briefly and then stops silently.
All checks passed. You can now enable the accessibility service.
Service is running, but setup is incomplete — it will stop working without warning. Finish the checks below.
Service running
A silent, ongoing notification shown while the skip service is active. It exists so device memory cleaners are less likely to stop Ad Skipper.
Ad Skipper is active
Watching YouTube for skippable ads.
Ad Skipper is INACTIVE

Android is not letting it read the screen, so no ads will be skipped. Turn Ad Skipper off and back on in Accessibility settings. If it keeps happening, allow the app to run in the background without restriction. Tap here to open the app.
Ad Skipper is NOT CONFIGURED
The service is running, but the setup checks have not been completed, so it will stop working without warning. Tap here to finish setup.

Some Android devices stop background apps to save power. If ads stop being skipped, open App info below and allow Ad Skipper to run in the background without restriction. If your device lets you lock an app in Recents, lock this one too.\n\nOn stock Android the system restarts the service by itself and none of this is needed.
